what: ad-hoc re-signed app copy hangs at startup on a macOS keychain ACL prompt; --use-mock-keychain clears it
why_it_matters: The unfenced control arm is a ditto'd copy of the packaged app with one line changed and an ad-hoc re-sign. That changes the code identity, so the keychain item Electron safeStorage created under the original identity no longer matches its ACL. securityd raises a GUI approval prompt; unattended, the main thread blocks in SecItemCopyMatching forever, before the window and before the sidecar fork. Symptom is 'no CDP page' -- it reads like the mutated build is broken, and it is not.
same_family_as: docs/verification/2026-08-26-req138-1076-packaged-sandbox/results/hardened-blocked-keychain.json (#1076 hit the identical stack while trying to reach hardened runtime with an ad-hoc re-sign)

resolution: Both arms of the AC1 run launch with --use-mock-keychain. It is a stock Chromium switch that swaps safeStorage's backing store for an in-process mock; it touches no part of the shell/sandbox seam (cfg.shell, wrapper, sandbox-exec). Identical flags on both arms is the point -- results/*.json record the flag list under identity.launchFlags.
